correctness.rationale: The exact Hessian factorization holds for the full homogeneous pencil. Eliminating the two power variables from h=h_prime=0 leaves only the singular invariant S_n and the smooth invariant K_n. At K_n exactly gcd(n,2) residual roots are double, never higher, as h_second=2n^2(n-1)(n-2)^2. Branch and axis contacts follow from local expansions. All flex multiplicities sum to 3n(n-2). The standalone SymPy program checks algebraic steps and degree-specific examples but is not substituted for the uniform proof.
